# Ember food delivery app (code.in.30s)
Customer food ordering mobile app. Warm editorial minimal style: elegant SERIF display headings (Newsreader, with one italic orange accent phrase), clean geometric sans (DM Sans) for all UI text, big real overhead food photography with soft warm shadows, 20px radius cards, full-round pill chips and pill search bar, round icon category chips, soft diffuse warm-brown shadows, thin rounded line icons. NO emoji, NO illustrations, NO neon, NO purple/blue.
## Light: warm cream background #FBF4EC, cards white #FFFFFF with soft shadow rgba(120,70,40,0.10) and 1px #F0E3D6 border, ink espresso #2B1D14, secondary text #8C7B6E. ONE accent: orange #E8622C to terracotta #C9502A gradient for primary CTA, active chip, active nav, prices highlight. Peach tint #FDE3D2 for icon circles and soft chips. Gold #F2A93B for rating stars, small green #4E9A5B only for 'Free delivery'.

screens.title: Ember Home - Light Mode

outputComponents.text:
I have designed the **Ember** light mode home screen based on your specifications:

### Design Highlights
- **Editorial Typography & Hierarchy:** Styled the hero with an elegant serif display heading (*"Fresh & warm,"* with the italic terracotta accent phrase *"at your door"*), paired with clean sans-serif UI typography for optimal legibility.
- **Warm Editorial Color Palette:** Applied the warm cream background (`#FBF4EC`), pure white cards with delicate `1px #F0E3D6` borders and soft warm drop shadows, espresso text (`#2B1D14`), secondary muted labels (`#8C7B6E`), and the signature warm orange gradient (`#E8622C` to `#C9502A`).
- **Overhead Culinary Photography:** Integrated realistic overhead food photography for the hero bowl, the weekend deal card, and the restaurant listings.
- **Component Details:**
  - **Top bar:** Avatar, delivery destination (*"24 Park Lane"*), and rounded notification action.
  - **Search & Filter:** Pill-shaped search bar with an orange circle filter button.
  - **Category chips:** Circular icon chips featuring active *Burgers* in solid orange alongside peach-toned circles for *Pizza*, *Asian*, *Healthy*, and *More*.
  - **Weekend Deal Banner:** Gradient card highlighting *"30% off your first order"* with a clean `"EMBER30"` coupon pill.
  - **Curated Grid:** 2-column cards for *Harvest Bowl Co.* and *Napoli Wood Fire* featuring gold star ratings and the green `"Free delivery"` highlight.
  - **Bottom Navigation:** Clean 5-tab docked bar with active orange state on *Home*.

outputComponents.text:
Here is the **Ember Dish Detail screen** for the **Sesame Tofu Bowl** in the warm editorial Light mode:

### Design Highlights & Brand Alignment:
- **Hero Presentation**: Features a large circular overhead food presentation using the artisanal sesame tofu grain bowl image (`Overhead top-down flat-lay food photography of a colourful Sesame Tofu grain bowl with crispy golden sesame crusted tofu cubes, bright edamame, soft-boiled ramen egg with jammy yolk, sweet corn kernels, sliced cucumber, shredded red cabbage, and brown grain rice base, in a beautiful handcrafted ceramic bowl, placed on a soft warm cream surface (#FBF4EC), soft warm editorial studio lighting, subtle diffused shadows, minimal presentation, 8k resolution, Michelin-guide aesthetic food photography`), centered on a soft peach-cream backdrop with subtle ambient depth, flanked by minimal circular back and favorite actions.

- **Palette & Tokens**: Warm cream canvas (`#FBF4EC`), crisp white containers (`#FFFFFF`) with 1px border (`#F0E3D6`), deep espresso ink (`#2B1D14`), secondary warm gray (`#8C7B6E`), and amber-gold (`#F2A93B`) for ratings.
- **Micro-Badges & Copy**: Dedicated green (`#4E9A5B`) pill strictly for *'Free delivery'*, alongside prep time and calorie chips.
- **Customizable Extras**: Clean option list for *Extra avocado* (+$1.50, pre-selected in Ember accent orange), *Edamame* (+$1.00), and *Add salmon* (+$3.00), plus a kitchen notes input field.
- **Fixed Order Sheet**: Floating bottom bar with a tactile quantity stepper (`- 1 +`) and primary gradient CTA button (`#E8622C` to `#C9502A`) displaying `Add to cart · $16.00`. Removed bottom tab navigation for focused order flow.

screens.title: Ember - Cart & Checkout

outputComponents.text:
Here is the **Cart & Checkout** screen for **Ember** in warm editorial Light Mode, crafted precisely to your specifications:

### Design Highlights & Specifications:
- **Atmosphere & Palette**: Warm cream background (`#FBF4EC`) with pure white elevated cards (`#FFFFFF`), subtle warm ambient shadows, and crisp 1px borders (`#F0E3D6`). Ink espresso (`#2B1D14`) for high-contrast primary typography and muted warm taupe (`#8C7B6E`) for metadata and secondary labels.
- **Typography**: Header display set in serif (*Newsreader*) featuring the signature italic accent word (*Cart* in warm orange `#E8622C`). Clean geometric typography (*DM Sans*) across all order details and interactive elements.
- **Top Bar**: Fixed header with a rounded back button, centered title, and a subtle "Clear" action.
- **Delivery Section**: Prominent card featuring the map pin in a soft peach circle (`#FDE3D2`), address details, an orange "Change" action, and an arrival pill badge ("Arrives in 25–30 min").
- **Cart Items**: Three items rendered with overhead food photography, dish names, customization notes, prices, and pill-shaped quantity steppers:
  1. *Sesame Tofu Bowl* ($16.00, "Extra avocado")
  2. *Margherita Pizza* ($12.00, "Napoli Wood Fire")
  3. *Iced Matcha Latte* ($4.50, "Oat milk")
- **Promo Banner**: Dashed orange-bordered banner highlighting `EMBER30 applied` with the `-$9.75` deduction.
- **Order Breakdown**: Clear bill summary displaying subtotal ($32.50), delivery fee highlighting **Free** in green (`#4E9A5B`), promo discount, and an emphasized serif Total of **$22.75**.
- **Payment & Note Rows**: Quick-access cards for `Visa ending 4242` and apartment drop-off instructions.
- **Primary CTA**: Fixed full-width bottom pill button with the signature warm orange-to-terracotta gradient (`#E8622C` to `#C9502A`) reading "Place order — $22.75", with no bottom tab bar as requested.
